**NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT**

**THIS NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT** (the "Agreement") is entered into as of [Date] by and between:

**[Party A Name]**, with its principal address at [Address] ("Disclosing Party"), and

**[Party B Name]**, with its principal address at [Address] ("Receiving Party").

**WHEREAS**, the parties wish to explore a potential business partnership (the "Purpose"); and

**WHEREAS**, in connection with the Purpose, the Disclosing Party may disclose certain proprietary or confidential information to the Receiving Party.

**NOW, THEREFORE**, the parties agree as follows:

**1. Definition of Confidential Information.**  
"Confidential Information" means any non-public information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether orally, in writing, or in any other form, that is designated as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given the nature of the information and circumstances of disclosure. This includes, without limitation, business plans, financial data, customer lists, trade secrets, technical data, product specifications, and marketing strategies.

**2. Obligations of Receiving Party.**  
The Receiving Party agrees to:  
(a) Hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence;  
(b) Not disclose Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party;  
(c) Use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose;  
(d) Limit access to Confidential Information to those employees or representatives who have a need to know for the Purpose and who are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as restrictive as those in this Agreement;  
(e) Protect Confidential Information using the same degree of care used to protect its own confidential information, but no less than reasonable care.

**3. Exclusions.**  
Confidential Information does not include information that:  
(a) Was or becomes publicly known through no fault of the Receiving Party;  
(b) Was rightfully known to the Receiving Party prior to disclosure without an obligation of confidentiality;  
(c) Is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of or reference to Confidential Information; or  
(d) Is rightfully received from a third party without restriction on disclosure.

**4. Term.**  
This Agreement shall commence on the date above and continue for [Number] years from the date of disclosure, unless terminated earlier by written agreement. The obligations of confidentiality shall survive termination for a period of [Number] years.

**5. Return of Confidential Information.**  
Upon the Disclosing Party's written request, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy all copies of Confidential Information and certify such return or destruction in writing.

**6. No License or Warranty.**  
Nothing in this Agreement grants any license or right to use any intellectual property of the Disclosing Party. Confidential Information is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind.

**7. Remedies.**  
The Receiving Party acknowledges that monetary damages may be inadequate to remedy a breach of this Agreement. Accordingly, the Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief and any other equitable remedies, without the necessity of posting a bond, in addition to all other remedies available at law.

**8. Governing Law.**  
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of [State/Country], without regard to conflict of laws principles.

**9. Entire Agreement.**  
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous agreements, whether written or oral.

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first above written.

[Party A Name]  
Signature: ______________________  
Name: ______________________  
Title: ______________________  

[Party B Name]  
Signature: ______________________  
Name: ______________________  
Title: ______________________

**Note:** This is a template only and does not constitute legal advice. The parties should consult with independent legal counsel to ensure compliance with applicable laws and to tailor the agreement to their specific circumstances.
